verdict.rationale: Elicit is a SaaS research platform with a public API, so webhook subscriptions are a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The OpenAPI spec description lists Search, Sessions, Reports, Systematic Reviews and Research Agent paths but no webhooks, and Instant email alerts and Routines are adjacent notification and automation features, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
